description: This is the E.F. Johnson Random Number Generator based onAppendix 3, Section 3.1 of the FIPS 186-2 standard. It can be used whenrandom number generation is required for DSA usage or for more generalrandom number generation cases. This algorithm is used in the E.F. Johnson,Johnson Encryption Module (JEM), and the mobile and portable radios whichcontain the FIPS 140-2 validated SEM module.
